source_identity.manifest_reconstruction: Merge common_source_input_sha256 with each variant's source_input_sha256_overrides. Complete-manifest hash is SHA256 of sorted compact JSON with separators comma and colon.

method.compiler_flags: default; separate runtime cache per variant
method.elapsed_summary: median of 8 process medians; each process has 7 kernel times; all values retained
method.elapsed_process_order: four forward rotations followed by four reversed rotations
method.elapsed_excludes: compilation, startup, printing, and scoped-file I/O
method.instruction_scope: 8 kernel calls including warmup, with native runtime and GC; excludes startup/compiler/timers/printing
method.jit_instruction_markers: actual ORC execution of instrumented equivalent; every preexisting non-initializer raw LLVM function body is equal, but later whole-module optimization can differ
method.aot_instruction_scope: exact timing executable at f.kernel entry/return, including tail-transferred descendants; when original f.kernel is absent, markers enclose its complete source invocation even if a private fast callee remains
method.aot_original_kernel_symbol_absent: The original f.kernel symbol is absent; this does not assert all private fast callees were inlined. Renamed from the legacy raw aot_kernel_fully_inlined field.
method.compile_samples: 192 invocations: 4 rotated samples for 6 case labels, 4 variants and 2 stages; 5 unique source files because warmed short/long share one source; outputs must match preparation SHA256
method.timing_limit: descriptive shared-host results; small speedups or regressions do not establish precision

count_harness_correction.reason: Exact symbol matching correction: word-boundary regex falsely matched rf.f.kernel as f.kernel; the absent ordinary wrapper produced zero dumps. Repeat all32counts under one corrected harness identity.
count_harness_correction.failed_run_log_limit: The zero-dump Callgrind profile is retained. The wrapper validated printed checksums before its dump assertion but did not persist that run process output; corrected harness persists each attempt before assertions.
count_harness_correction.retry: All 32 final counts were repeated under the corrected exact-final-token symbol detector; none of the seven preliminary successes were reused.

json_aot_attribution.method: Noninclusive per-function instruction costs from the existing final profiles, grouped to account for inlining and out-of-line boxing. Group deltas mix code generation and recursion accounting; they are not a count of guard instructions alone.

performance_acceptance.elapsed_finding: The complete final series reports candidate object JIT +10.22% versus main and +10.03% versus prior. Separately labelled controls do not reproduce it consistently, despite matching relocated hot-function bytes and low sampled guest runqueue delay. The cause is unresolved; all data remain preserved and elapsed acceptance stays open.
